title: The MIZORAM EASE OF DOING BUSINESS ACT, 2022
full_text: The MIZORAM EASE OF DOING BUSINESS ACT, 2022 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20227 Act Number: 7 Enactment Date: 2022-03-31 Act Year: 2022 Short Title: The MIZORAM EASE OF DOING BUSINESS ACT, 2022 Long Title: PRELIMINARY 1. Short title, extent and commencement.- (a) This Act may be called the Mizoram Ease of Doing Business Act, 2022. (b) It extends to the whole of the State of Mizoram. (c) It shall come into force from the date of notification in the official Gazette.
